# Going live

> Production access steps and the go-live checklist.

## 11.1 What you need

- UAT signed off by InnBucks, and the video accepted ([10.4](testing-and-uat.md#104-submit-for-sign-off))
- All account-opening documentation completed with InnBucks
- Your business administrator nominated, so you can use the business portal ([3.4](onboarding.md#34-nominate-your-business-administrator))

## 11.2 Steps

1. InnBucks sets up your production account and sends **production API credentials** and the
   **production base URL**.
2. InnBucks explains how to **pre-fund your merchant account**. If you do deposits, bank
   change or utility payments, expect them to draw on that balance.
3. InnBucks trains you on the **reversal process**, help-desk queries and contacts, and
   **merchant statements** (including online access through the business portal).
4. Switch your configuration: production base URL, API key, username, password and
   `INNBUCKS_ENV=production` (which switches the deep link to `com.innbucks.customer://`).
5. Make one small real payment end to end and check that it appears on your statement.

## 11.3 Go-live checklist

- [ ] Production credentials are in the secret manager, not in code or in the repository
- [ ] Base URL, API key, username and password all come from the **same** environment
- [ ] Deep links use `com.innbucks.customer://purchase?paymentToken=`
- [ ] The token is cached and refreshed at 14 minutes; `401` triggers one re-login
- [ ] Amounts are sent as integer cents everywhere (check a US$4.50 order sends `450`)
- [ ] `narration` carries your unique reference, for statement reconciliation
- [ ] Code inquiries run in a background job, one per code every 30 seconds
- [ ] Orders are fulfilled only on `Claimed` or `Paid`, and only once
- [ ] Money-moving requests are never re-sent after a timeout
- [ ] Every call logs `responseCode`, message, HTTP status and `X-Trace-Id`, and no secrets
- [ ] The payment screen follows the brand guidelines ([5.6](payments.md#56-brand-and-display-guidelines))
- [ ] Someone reconciles the InnBucks statement against your orders daily
